name: 草绿果园故事露水鲜冬枣款
description: 清新草绿胶囊徽章版式，露水现摘、自然农法种植故事、果肉细腻的鲜冬枣套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: crisp grass green #4CA33C poster panels alternating with light mint green #EAF6DA sections and pure white #FFFFFF photo cards
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft natural daylight around 5500K, gentle top light, fine dewy mist, soft contact shadows, fresh picked mood, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: natural light wood boards, straw woven mats, blue-and-white porcelain bowls and fresh green leaves
styleLock.typography: modern rounded sans-serif short headlines only, one family, labels 10-14pt
styleLock.iconSystem: capsule-shaped pill headers, thin-line circular callout outlines and small round numbered seals, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable fruit scale across the set, naturally glossy speckled skin with fine water droplets, halved fruit shows pale crisp flesh and a small slender pit, every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: {style_lock} consistent fresh orchard produce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of crisp grass green #4CA33C panels, light mint green #EAF6DA sections, pure white #FFFFFF photo areas and cards, deep green #2E6B1E text on light panels, white #FFFFFF text on green panels, and one porcelain cobalt blue accent #2E5FA3; soft natural daylight around 5500K with gentle top light, fine dewy mist, soft contact shadows, fresh picked mood; modern rounded sans-serif short headlines only; consistent capsule-shaped pill headers, thin-line circular callout outlines and small round numbered seals; natural light wood boards, straw woven mats, blue-and-white porcelain bowls and fresh green leaves with clean food photography mixed with minimal infographic cards; stable fruit scale, naturally glossy speckled skin with fine water droplets, never plastic; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched badge styles, no plastic-looking fruit.

provenance.notes: 从 8 张草绿版式冬枣详情长图切片提炼，与库内 suite-shengxianliangyou-dongzao（深松绿金线国风款）以版式语法与卖点结构区分；已剥离源品牌信息、会员二维码、原文案与不可验证声明（种植条件/无化肥/维生素C/会员优惠等一律改为 {callout} 占位，无法核实的证据类信息不在图中呈现，由使用方按实际资质补充），产品一律以 {product} 占位。
